Tool shape. docs/workbench/11-designer-and-operator.md section "First public Pi tools (proposed)": "workflow_execute(definitionRef,input,hostMode,policy?): authorized launch; returns logical invocation and native references, not false completion." -> decideExecute accepts exactly {definitionRef, input, hostMode, policy?}; the reply built from an injected launch outcome carries the logical invocation reference and the native references the launch reported, and a status that is launch-level only (e.g. accepted/launched/refused); asserting a completed/successful terminal state from a launch outcome is impossible by construction (falsifier test).
E2. Immutable digest. docs/workbench/11 section "Operator actions versus designer edits": "Design-time edits occur against versioned source; execution against immutable digest." -> a definitionRef that is not digest-pinned is refused with a typed diagnostic before any grant check consumes it.
E3. Exact execute authority. docs/workbench/06-capability-registry.md: "Registered descriptors do not grant access." and "Catalog discovery independently requires exact `discover:<capabilityId>`." plus docs/workbench/02 WB-034: "list/inspect never grant invoke." -> admission requires one exact execute-authority grant distinct from workbench:design, workbench:observe and every discover:/inspect: grant; proven both ways (grant present admits, grant absent refuses typed); a grant set holding only discover:/inspect:/design/observe grants NEVER admits (falsifier).
E4. No node-permission leakage. docs/workbench/06: "Invocation requires every explicit producer permission in the descriptor." -> the reply never claims or implies node-level capability permissions; it echoes the policy input verbatim-bounded and leaves per-node admission to the host registry seam.
E5. hostMode allowlist. docs/workbench/17-packaging-and-operations.md section "Install profile" separates "embedded Pi extension with local Claude SDK host" from "optional headless executor library/process for detached runs" -> hostMode is a closed allowlist (embedded, detached); an unknown hostMode is a typed refusal, never a guessed default.
E6. Sanitized bounded reply. Every string in the reply routes through the shared sanitizers (src/workbench/redaction.ts) and the reply is byte-capped with a visible truncation marker; raw launch payloads are never retained.
E7. Purity. The module performs no I/O, imports no SDK and never invokes the registry; vitest covers refusal and admission paths; biome clean; no any; no inline imports; no existing test weakened.
